browser-settings.title: Browser
browser-settings.scope: Choose the browser that opens links on this computer. Changes apply immediately to every DeliDev window.
browser-settings.generalHelp: Browser used to open web links
browser-settings.localHelp: Browser used to open localhost and loopback addresses
browser-settings.authNote: Sign-in and account authorization links always open in the system default browser.
browser-settings.discoveryFailed: Installed browsers could not be listed. The system default browser is still available.
browser-settings.noBrowsers: No other browsers that open web links were found. The system default browser is still available.
browser-settings.unavailableSaved: A saved browser is not installed. Its links will not open until you choose another browser.
browser-settings.notInstalled: That browser is no longer installed. Refresh the list and choose another browser.
browser-settings.webUnavailable: Browser selection is available only in the DeliDev desktop app.
browser-settings.readFailed: Browser settings could not be read. Reload them before trying again.
browser-settings.invalidDocument: The saved browser settings are damaged and were not changed. Reset them to use the system default browser for all links.
browser-settings.unsupportedVersion: The saved browser settings come from a newer DeliDev version and were not changed. Reset them to use the system default browser for all links.
browser-settings.writeFailed: The browser setting was not saved. Reload the saved settings before trying again.
browser-settings.outcomeUnknown: DeliDev could not confirm whether the browser setting was saved. Reload the saved settings before trying again.
browser-settings.changed: Another DeliDev window changed these settings. Reload them and try again.
